concept.hr: Strogi prioritet ili težinska podjela veze; pun red odbacuje pridošlicu
concept.en: Strict priority vs weighted fair queuing; a full queue drops the newcomer

summary.hr: Glas, video i skupni prijenos na zagušenoj vezi: zadaj promet, duljinu reda i težine i gledaj tko gubi pakete, a tko čeka u redu.
summary.en: Voice, video and bulk on a congested link: set the traffic, the queue limit and the weights, and see who loses packets and who waits.
